content: Nindokon Sehoiakim eh wiewia nanmwarki, Nepukadnesar, nanmwarkien Papilon ahpw mahweniong Suda, oh erein sounpar siluh Sehoiakim idihdohng en wiahki Nepukadnesar eh kaun oh peikiong; mwuhr, e ahpw pelianda.

KAUN-O eri ketin kadarala mehn Papilonia, mehn Siria, oh mehn Ammon, pwe re en mahweniong Sehoiakim oh kamwomwala Suda, nin duwen me KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong sapwellime ladu soukohp ko me e pahn ketin wia.
Met pweida sang ni sapwellimen Koht koasoandi, pwehn kasohrehla mehn Suda sang mwohn silangi pwehki dihp koaros me Nanmwarki Manase wiadahr,
ahpw mehlel pwehki aramas mwakelekel koaros me e kemelahr. KAUN-O sohte kak kupwurmahkohng Manase pwehki dihpo.
Mehkoaros me Sehoiakim wiadahr ntinting nan Pwuken Poadopoad en Nanmwarki kan en Suda.
Sehoiakim sipalla, oh sapwellime pwutak Sehoiakin me uhd wiliandi wiahla nanmwarki.

Nanmwarkien Isip oh sapwellime karis sohla pwurehng mwekidsang nan Isip, pwehki nanmwarkien Papilonia eh uhd sapwellimanikihla manaman pohn sahpw ako koaros me uhdahn sapwen Isip, sang Pillap Iupreitis kolahng paliepeng en irepen Isip.
Sehoiakin Nanmwarkien Suda
Sehoiakin sounpar eisek waluh ni ahnsou me e wiahla nanmwarkien Suda; e ahpw ketin kakaun nan Serusalem erein sounpwong siluh. Eh nohno mwarenki Nehusda, nein Elnadan, mehn Serusalem.
Sehoiakin ahpw wiahda me sapwung mwohn silangin KAUN-O, duwehte semeo.
Ni ahnsowo, karis en sounpeien Papilonia, me sapwellimen Nanmwarki Nepukadnesar lapalap akan kaunda, pwarodo oh kapilpene Serusalem.
Pein Nepukadnesar ketido Serusalem nindokon sapwellime sounpei ko ar mahmahweniong wasao.

Eri, Nanmwarki Sehoiakin ahpw ketieila oh ketin peki mahk rehn nanmwarkien Papilonia, iangahki ine, sapwellime pwutak ko, oh sapwellime lapalap akan, oh pil lapalap akan en nan tehnpeseo. Eri, ni kawaluhn sounpar en sapwellime mwehi, Nepukadnesar ahpw ketin salihedi Sehoiakin;

e ahpw ketikihsang kepwe kesempwal koaros en Tehnpas Sarawio oh dipwisou kesempwal en tehnpas en nanmwarkio. Nin duwen KAUN-O eh ketin kohpadahro, Nepukadnesar pil ketin kauwehla dahl kohl koaros me Nanmwarki Solomon ketin wiadahng Tehnpas Sarawio.

E ahpw ketin salihedi oh ketikihda tohn Serusalem koaros, soupeidi oh soumas koaros, irail koaros me 10,000, iangahki sounwia mete oh tohndoadoahk koahiek koaros; ihte me luhwehdi, soangen aramas me keieu semwehmwe kan.
Nepukadnesar eri ketin salihalahng Sehoiakin nan Papilon, iangahki eh nohno, eh pwoud kan, sapwellime soumas akan, oh pil aramas kesempwal koaros en sahpwo.
E pil ketin salihalahng Papilonia ohl kepwehpwe koaros, irail me 7,000, oh sounwia mete oh tohndoadoahk koahiek 1,000; irail koaros me kehlail oh kakohng iang mahwen.
Nepukadnesar ahpw ketin kasapwilada Madanaia, rien semen Sehoiakin, pwe en wiliandi Sehoiakin oh wiahla nanmwarkien Suda; e ahpw ketikihong mware Sedekaia.
Sedekaia Nanmwarkien Suda
Sedekaia sounpar rieisek ehu ahnsou me e kesepwilda wiahla nanmwarki; e ahpw ketin kakaun nan Serusalem erein sounpar eisek ehu. Mwaren eh nohno Amudal, nein Seremaia, mehn kahnimw Lipna.
Nanmwarki Sedekaia ahpw wiahda me sapwung mwohn silangin KAUN-O, duwehte Nanmwarki Sehoiakim.
Tohn Serusalem oh Suda pwon eri kahngiangihada KAUN-O, me kahrehda e ketin keseirailla sang mwohn silangi.
